dataset_when2call.name: When2Call llm_judge
dataset_when2call.selection_rule: round-robin across gold labels, uuid sorted within label, n=40; IDs frozen in frontloop-published-subset-v0

dataset_loc.name: Loc-Bench V1 Security Vulnerability
dataset_loc.selection_rule: all official Security Vulnerability rows; do not drop django/HA/pip for size

metrics.when2call_format: canonical JSON with action in {tool_call, request_for_info, cannot_answer}; coffee-style {tool,args} aliases to tool_call
metrics.when2call_semantic: predicted action == gold correct_answer; tool name match is secondary only
metrics.loc_format: canonical JSON tool+args or final path::func

independent.reset: fresh prompt, no history, no tool execution

itt.rerun: new id; never overwrite a failure with a later success

_publication_note: Portable configuration template derived from the archived f0.json. Local model paths and editorial metadata were adjusted for publication; this is not an untouched historical run manifest.
